title: RuntimeServerService
responsibility: Serves any runtime over loopback HTTP as an independently running unit.

inputs.name: RuntimeServerService.serve.runtime
inputs.description: The unit runtime passed to runtimeReply for each request handled by this server. This service passes it directly to the request adapter.

inputs.name: RuntimeServerService.serve.options
inputs.description: The listening port and optional host supplied to Node's HTTP server. When host is omitted it defaults to 127.0.0.1; the service does not add authentication.

outputs.name: RuntimeServerService.serve
outputs.description: Resolves after the HTTP listener starts with the bound URL and a close() function. The URL uses the selected host and actual bound port; close() terminates active connections before closing the server.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The Node server error is propagated if binding fails while serve is listening.
